title: The Lost Coin
reflectionQuestion: The woman searched and swept and would not give up until she found her little coin. I wonder how it feels to know that God looks for you just like that?
kidSafetyNotes: Claims OPEN registry anchor lost_coin (Jesus' Parables; was short-only/launch:false -> now short+full, claimed). Adam's 'lost-toy energy' tweak baked in: under the table, in the corners, swept and swept, would not give up -> 'I found it!' pure joy -> celebration. Room = God looks for lost things / you are precious / never gives up (relatable: lost stuffed animals, blankets, toys). Counting beat (one..ten) is participatory for 4-7. Soft close ('joy of all'). VOICE_MIRIAM_JOYFUL (lively, celebratory -- carries the finding-joy).
